mapper.sql: id, job_uid, card_uid, base_revision_uid, template_key, template_version, status, attempt_count, request_json, result_revision_uid, error_code, error_message, available_at, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vocabulary_generation_job WHERE status = 'pending' AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY available_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM vocabulary_generation_job WHERE card_uid = #{cardUid} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'running', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_uid = #{jobUid} AND status = 'pending' AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'succeeded', result_revision_uid = #{revisionUid}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_uid = #{jobUid} AND status = 'running'

UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'failed' 'pending' , error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, available_at = #{availableAt}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NULL , updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_uid = #{jobUid} AND status = 'running'
UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'cancelled', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_uid = #{jobUid} AND status IN ('pending', 'running')
UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'cancelled', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE card_uid = #{cardUid} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'pending', available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'running' AND started_at < #{staleBefore}
